response.original_title: No Life Defined: Yao Miao ’s Rise as a Trail Running Icon
response.overview: Yao Miao began running within China’s sporting system with the goal of supporting her family. Facing adversity and breaking barriers, she has become a pioneer in trail running while inspiring new generations in China and beyond. A moving story about ambition, family, and the power of sport.
response.title: No Life Defined: Yao Miao ’s Rise as a Trail Running Icon
